title: Common Institutional Ownership and Product Market Threats
eligible_reason: Stacked DiD around 27 institutional-investor mergers: KLS_Fluidity_data_institutional_mergers.dta is a merger-firm-year panel (dealnum x firmid x eventyear, no calendar year variable), and every Table 3-8 regression is reghdfe y c.post##c.treatment $control_1 if eventyear in [-2,2] or [-3,3], absorb(eventyear#dealnum firmid#dealnum), i.e. deal-specific event windows with deal x event-year and deal x firm FE, plus eight time-varying firm controls in every column. Table 2 (firm-year panel) regresses fluidity on a continuous common-ownership measure (mhhid_1) with controls. Appendix B is a probit.
design_notes: KLS_Fluidity_STATA_replication_institutional_mergers.do: Table 3 (common-ownership first stage: mhhid, cross, ggl), Table 4 (fluidity, similarity, industry splits and triple interactions with hhi_1, techproximity_1, lnppe_1, totalsimilarity_1), Table 6 (wordcounts), Table 7 (investments), Table 8 (roa). treatment4qtr_p alternative treatment; recommended==1 subsample. 113,225 rows, 27 deals, 4,586 firms. Firm IDs are random numbers generated from gvkey.
estimators_reported: stacked_did_with_controls (deal x event-year, deal x firm FE)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: 27 merger events stacked; event-year only, calendar year not in the analysis file.

specs.exclusion_reason: stacked design (eventyear#dealnum, firmid#dealnum FE) and time-varying controls in every column
specs.treatment_definition: treatment = firm held by both merging institutions; post = after the deal
specs.controls: hhi_1 lnat_1 lnage_1 tobinq_1 roa_1 leverage_1 cash_1 volatility_1
specs.reported_location: Table 4 Panel A (same structure in Tables 3, 6-8)

data_files_note: Analysis files shipped; firm IDs anonymized (random numbers from gvkey). Raw Compustat/13F inputs licensed; Hoberg-Phillips variables included.
